verdict.stance: Overweight / Sovereign-Capped Global Top-4 Gold Producer (BB Pos / BB)
verdict.summary: World's 4th-largest gold producer (3.15Moz/yr) delivering exceptional cash conversion: H126 revenue jumped 49.9% YoY to $7.07bn with Adj EBITDA of $4.89bn (69.2% margin) and net leverage just 0.3x ($2.36bn net debt YE25 vs $6.95bn FY25 EBITDA). Fitch assesses SCP at bb+ (capped at BB Positive by Uzbekistan sovereign).

positives: Tier-1 global scale (Muruntau open-pit mega-mine, 3.15Moz FY25 gold output) and 69.2% H126 EBITDA margin.
Ultra-low 0.3x net leverage ($2.36bn net debt YE25 vs $4.65bn FY25 CFO); Fitch SCP bb+ sits above sovereign BB.
Clean $1.5bn Eurobond maturity ladder (2028/2030/2031) with no near-term refinancing wall.
negatives: Sovereign cap (BB Positive Fitch / BB Stable S&P) and high fiscal extraction (royalties/dividends to Uzbek state).
AISC inflation to $1,647/oz in H126 (from $1,164/oz H125) driven by price-linked mineral extraction tax and Muruntau stripping.
Single-commodity (gold) price sensitivity and Muruntau asset concentration.

background.business_overview: Uzbekistan's flagship state-owned gold mining group (top-4 globally), producing ~3.15Moz gold annually led by the Muruntau complex.
background.asset_perimeter: Muruntau open pit and regional gold mining/processing complexes across Uzbekistan.
background.ownership_governance: 100% Republic of Uzbekistan; IFRS audited financials.
